description: This PHP file is a controller class for handling system restore operations within the admin panel of an OpenCart-based project. It provides functions to initiate a restore task and to read and process SQL dump files, executing SQL commands while avoiding certain sensitive tables.

classes.name: Restore
classes.description: Controller class for performing system restore tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes a restore task by validating the filename, preparing the environment, and scheduling the restore process.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a SQL dump file from a specified position and executes SQL statements, with safeguards to avoid certain tables, and updates the task progress.
